headline: Non-executive director acquires 50,000 units
summary: A non-executive director purchased 50,000 units at $2.18 per unit, increasing their total holding to 410,000 units.

headline: $85m placement to fund $120m Northshore Clinics acquisition
summary: Coralwave raises $85m at $1.42 per share, a 9.5% discount, to fund the $120m acquisition of Northshore Clinics. The acquisition is expected to be EPS accretive in its first full year.

headline: Pit wall failure cuts FY27 copper guidance, raises costs
summary: Kestrel mine haul road closed ~8 weeks after pit wall failure. FY27 copper production guidance lowered to 180-195kt; AISC up 12% to A$4.85/lb. No injuries; remediation underway.

headline: Half-year revenue up 31% to $48.2m, first positive operating cash flow
summary: Quokka Software reported strong revenue growth and achieved its first positive operating cash flow. Full-year guidance remains unchanged, indicating management confidence.

headline: CEO resigns after six years, effective 31 January 2027
summary: The long-serving CEO is departing. The board is searching for a successor, with the CFO to act as interim CEO if needed. Leadership uncertainty may weigh on investor sentiment.

headline: All AGM resolutions passed on a poll
summary: Routine annual general meeting outcome; all resolutions were approved by shareholders. No material impact expected for investors.
